jobs.description: Why State Street State Street is one of the world's leading providers of financial services to institutional investors. Investment Services is a core strategic business within State Street, delivering custody, fund administration, accounting, transfer agency, middle-office, and related asset servicing solutions to many of the world's largest asset managers, asset owners, alternatives firms, insurance companies, and institutional investors globally. As the financial services industry continues to evolve, Investment Services is at the center of significant regulatory change, technology modernization, operational transformation, and product innovation. Legal plays a critical role in helping the business navigate these opportunities and challenges while supporting growth, risk management, client service, and operational excellence. This role offers an experienced legal executive the opportunity to: Serve as a senior legal leader supporting one of State Street's most important global businesses. Partner directly with executive leaders across Product, Operations, Technology, Risk, Compliance, Audit, Procurement, and Client organizations. Influence product strategy, operating model evolution, regulatory implementation, commercial arrangements, and enterprise transformation initiatives. Lead and develop a sophisticated team of attorneys and legal professionals. Drive legal strategy across a broad portfolio of products, services, jurisdictions, and client segments. Operate at the intersection of business strategy, innovation, operational execution, governance, and risk management. For a legal executive seeking significant business influence, executive visibility, leadership responsibility, and the opportunity to shape a global asset servicing franchise, this role offers a compelling next step. Overview of the Investment Services (Americas) Legal Team The Investment Services (Americas) Legal team provides strategic advice and counsel to business and control colleagues in accordance with the highest standards of judgment, integrity, and ethical leadership. The team partners closely with clients and internal stakeholders to deliver practical, business-oriented legal solutions that support State Street's alternatives, asset manager, asset owner, and insurance clients throughout the Americas. The team advises on a broad range of asset servicing products and services, including custody, accounting, trustee, transfer agency, fund administration, and related solutions. Responsibilities span product development, client relationships, operational strategy, technology transformation, regulatory matters, governance, risk management, and complex commercial arrangements across multiple jurisdictions. Who We Are Looking For We are seeking a seasoned attorney, strategic advisor, and enterprise leader to serve as Managing Director, Investment Services Product & Operations Legal . In this highly visible leadership role, you will lead and develop a team of attorneys and legal professionals supporting State Street's Investment Services Product and Operations organizations. You will serve as a trusted advisor to senior executives and key stakeholders on legal, regulatory, operational, commercial, and strategic matters affecting some of the firm's most critical products, services, operating models, and transformation initiatives. Unlike legal roles focused primarily on a specific client segment or regulatory framework, this position requires a broad enterprise perspective across Investment Services. The successful candidate will develop a comprehensive understanding of State Street's products, services, operating models, and delivery capabilities across client segments, jurisdictions, and functional areas. This individual will help drive consistency, scalability, operational effectiveness, and strategic alignment across a complex global asset servicing platform. The ideal candidate will combine deep financial services legal expertise with strong business judgment, operational fluency, and leadership capabilities. They will influence key decisions at the most senior levels of the organization while helping shape the future evolution of Investment Services products, operations, technology, and service delivery models. What You Will Be Responsible For Strategic Legal and Business Advisory Act as a trusted legal advisor to senior business leaders responsible for Investment Services products, operations, and transformation initiatives. Provide practical and actionable legal advice regarding Investment Services clients, products, and operations, including custody, accounting, trustee, transfer agency, fund administration, and related asset servicing solutions. Counsel business leaders on legal, regulatory, operational, commercial, financial, and reputational risks associated with product strategy, operating model evolution, client service activities, and strategic initiatives. Translate complex legal and regulatory matters into practical, commercially oriented guidance that supports business objectives. Develop legal strategies that enable innovation while appropriately managing risk. Enterprise Product and Operating Model Leadership Develop a comprehensive understanding of Investment Services products, services, operating models, and delivery capabilities across client segments, jurisdictions, and functional areas. Advise business leaders on legal implications associated with product strategy, operating model evolution, service delivery optimization, and cross-business initiatives. Support efforts to simplify, standardize, and scale legal support frameworks across products and services operating in multiple geographies and client segments. Partner with Product, Operations, Technology, and Transformation leaders to drive consistency, efficiency, governance, and strategic alignment across the Investment Services franchise. Evaluate legal and regulatory implications of initiatives that affect multiple products, client segments, jurisdictions, or operating environments. Product, Operations and Transformation Support Provide legal guidance throughout the product lifecycle, including design, enhancement, commercialization, client implementation, and regulatory change. Support major transformation initiatives, technology modernization programs, outsourcing arrangements, operating model redesigns, acquisitions, integrations, and organizational changes. Advise on legal considerations associated with emerging technologies, digital initiatives, service delivery strategies, and evolving operational capabilities. Partner with Product and Operations leadership to support business growth, innovation, and operational excellence. Commercial and Client Matters Oversee the drafting, review, negotiation, and interpretation of complex asset servicing agreements, disclosures, client communications, and related documentation. Advise on strategic commercial arrangements involving clients, vendors, third-party providers, and business partners. Support significant client negotiations, escalations, and issue resolution efforts. Establish consistent legal approaches and governance frameworks across products, services, and contractual arrangements. Risk, Regulatory, and Cross-Functional Partnership Partner with Compliance, Risk, Audit, Technology, Procurement, Operations, and other control functions on regulatory change, governance enhancements, incident response, remediation efforts, and strategic initiatives. Support regulatory examinations, inquiries, remediation programs, claims, disputes, and interactions with regulators and industry utilities. Evaluate legal, regulatory, operational, commercial, and reputational risks and escalate significant matters when appropriate. Drive consistency and continuous improvement across legal processes, risk assessment frameworks, governance models, and business support activities. Leadership Responsibilities Lead, manage, mentor, and develop a high-performing team of attorneys and legal professionals supporting a broad portfolio of Investment Services products, operations, and enterprise initiatives. Establish the strategic direction and priorities for the team while ensuring effective allocation of legal resources across a complex and evolving global business. Serve as a member of the senior Legal leadership team, helping shape talent strategies, risk management approaches, governance frameworks, operating models, and organizational priorities. Influence business and legal strategy through active participation in senior management discussions involving products, operations, technology modernization, transformation initiatives, regulatory change, and business growth. Build succession plans and develop future legal leaders through coaching, mentorship, sponsorship, and professional development. Foster a culture of accountability, collaboration, sound judgment, ethical leadership, inclusion, and continuous improvement. Promote alignment and partnership across legal teams supporting different client segments, products, jurisdictions, and functional areas. Drive operational excellence through effective delegation, prioritization, governance, resource management, and knowledge sharing. Help ensure consistency of legal advice, risk evaluation, and business support across the broader Investment Services franchise. What We Value The successful candidate will be a strategic legal executive with broad financial services legal and regulatory expertise, deep knowledge of asset servicing products and operating models, and the ability to advise executive stakeholders on complex strategic, operational, commercial, and regulatory matters. The individual will bring: Executive presence and the credibility to influence senior leaders across a complex global organization. A broad enterprise perspective and the ability to understand how products, operations, technology, and client delivery models interact across multiple client segments and jurisdictions. Exceptional judgment and the ability to make well-reasoned decisions in complex, high-pressure, or ambiguous situations. A practical, commercially focused approach to legal advice and problem solving. Strategic leadership skills and the ability to align legal priorities with evolving business objectives. The ability to identify opportunities to simplify, standardize, and optimize legal support models across a large-scale global platform. Strong leadership capabilities and a demonstrated commitment to developing future legal leaders. A collaborative approach and the ability to build trusted relationships across Legal, Product, Operations, Technology, Risk, Compliance, Audit, and client-facing organizations. A commitment to integrity, accountability, disciplined risk management, and ethical leadership. Qualifications Juris Doctor from an accredited U.S. law school and active license to practice law in good standing in at least one U.S. jurisdiction. 15+ years of legal experience in financial services, including experience at a law firm, financial institution, or preferably a combination of both. Significant experience advising financial institutions, asset servicing organizations, custodian banks, asset managers, or other institutional financial services businesses. Deep understanding of institutional asset servicing products, services, operating models, and delivery frameworks, including custody, accounting, trustee services, fund administration, transfer agency, ETF servicing, middle-office services, collateral services, securities lending, and related solutions. Demonstrated ability to advise on legal, regulatory, operational, and commercial matters affecting products and services across multiple client segments, jurisdictions, and operating environments. Experience supporting enterprise-wide initiatives involving product strategy, operating model evolution, technology modernization, outsourcing, global delivery models, business transformation, or organizational change. Strong understanding of how Product, Operations, Technology, Risk, Compliance, and Client Service functions interact within a large-scale financial services organization. Demonstrated ability to lead legal teams, manage complex matters, and provide sound judgment in high-pressure environments. Proven experience advising senior executives and influencing decision-making across Legal, Operations, Product, Technology, Risk, Compliance, and business leadership teams. Experience negotiating and overseeing sophisticated commercial agreements, strategic partnerships, outsourcing arrangements, and client-facing contracts. Ability to evaluate legal, regulatory, operational, financial, and reputational risks and provide practical recommendations that support business objectives. Experience interacting with regulators, industry organizations, outside counsel, and senior external stakeholders. Exceptional analytical, drafting, negotiation, communication, client service, and problem-solving skills. Strong organizational, leadership, and resource management capabilities, including talent development, succession planning, and team leadership. Experience supporting large-scale operational transformation, technology modernization, regulatory implementation, or enterprise change programs within a highly regulated environment. Ability to thrive in a dynamic global environment and provide practical, business-oriented legal advice across a broad and evolving portfolio of products and services. Why This Role Is Distinctive This position combines the reach of a global financial institution with the influence of a senior legal leadership mandate. The successful candidate will not simply provide legal advice on individual products or matters. They will help shape how Investment Services products, operations, and delivery models evolve across client segments, jurisdictions, and business functions. They will influence strategic decisions, help drive transformation, optimize risk management approaches, and support the continued evolution of State Street's global asset servicing franchise. For a legal executive seeking broad business impact, executive visibility, meaningful people leadership, and the opportunity to operate horizontally across one of the industry's leading Investment Services businesses, this role offers a unique and compelling opportunity. jobs.description: NVIDIA has continuously reinvented itself over two decades. Our invention of the GPU in 1999 sparked the growth of the PC gaming market, redefined modern computer graphics, and revolutionized parallel computing. More recently, GPU deep learning ignited modern AI — the next era of computing. NVIDIA is a “learning machine” that constantly evolves by adapting to new opportunities that are hard to solve, that only we can tackle, and that matter to the world. This is our life’s work , to amplify human imagination and intelligence. Make the choice to join us today. Design-for-Test Engineering at NVIDIA works on groundbreaking innovations involving crafting creative solutions for DFT architecture, verification and post-silicon validation on some of the industry's most complex semiconductor chips. About Anthropic
Anthropic’s mission is to create reliable, interpretable, and steerable AI systems. We want AI to be safe and beneficial for our users and for society as a whole. Our team is a quickly growing group of committed researchers, engineers, policy experts, and business leaders working together to build beneficial AI systems.
About the role
Anthropic is seeking an Enterprise Integrated Campaign Manager to design, orchestrate, scale, and measure integrated marketing campaigns that support our Enterprise business priorities and drive demand, adoption, and expansion across our most strategic customer segments. As a key member of our marketing organization, you'll build the campaign frameworks and cross-channel motions that connect our content, physical events, digital programs, and account-based efforts into cohesive journeys that move enterprise buyers from awareness to activation.
This role requires a sophisticated understanding of B2B marketing with demonstrated success in integrated campaign strategy and execution across the full customer lifecycle. You'll develop and execute comprehensive campaign strategies in partnership with Sales, Field Marketing, Product Marketing, Partner Marketing, and Digital teams, creating compelling programs and flywheel motions that empower the Enterprise Sales team to achieve their pipeline and revenue targets.
Enterprise represents one of our largest growth opportunities and our most nuanced challenge, a segment where long sales cycles, complex buying committees, and industry-specific requirements demand campaigns that are deeply orchestrated rather than one-size-fits-all. You'll work closely with Product and Field Marketing, the broader Integrated Campaigns team, and cross-functional partners to ensure campaigns directly support demand generation, customer adoption, and strategic account expansion.
Key responsibilities
Design and lead integrated campaigns across customer segments, establishing scalable frameworks and processes that connect digital, events, content, and ABM channels into cohesive buyer journeys
Drive full-funnel campaign initiatives across core Enterprise priorities, industries, and segments, adapting strategies for diverse buying committees and enterprise purchasing behaviors
Create and implement campaign programs including thought leadership moments, digital nurture streams, webinar series, executive engagement programs, and ABM activations
Partner closely with Field Marketing to align campaign programs with territory and account-specific goals that directly achieve pipeline, adoption, and expansion targets
Optimizing programs to measurement frameworks including lead scoring, attribution models, and ROI reporting to demonstrate campaign impact on demand, adoption, and revenue
Collaborate with global Marketing teams to ensure Enterprise campaigns align with company-wide strategy while meeting segment- and industry-specific needs
Coordinate with Product Marketing and Solutions Marketing to ensure consistent messaging and positioning across all campaign touchpoints
Manage campaign resources including agency partners, vendors, and internal creative and content teams to deliver programs on time and on budget
Build and manage campaign budgets with strong financial discipline and ROI focus
Drive continuous improvement through post-campaign analysis, stakeholder feedback, and data-driven optimization
Minimum qualifications
Demonstrate deep understanding of B2B enterprise sales cycles and buying processes - experience working within software companies is required for this position
Have a track record of successfully building and scaling integrated campaign programs that span digital, events, content, and ABM channels
Have strong analytical skills and a data-driven approach to campaign optimization and attribution
Have demonstrated success in contributing to significant demand, adoption, and revenue goals through integrated marketing initiatives
Are a proven self-starter who can build and run sophisticated programs with small teams in fast-paced startup environments
Have strong project management skills with experience managing complex, multi-channel campaigns simultaneously
Possess strong budgeting and financial management capabilities with experience managing substantial campaign budgets
Excel at cross-functional collaboration, particularly with sales teams, agency partners, and executive stakeholders
Are comfortable with ambiguity and thrive in fast-paced, evolving environments with a bias for thoughtful action
Preferred qualifications
Have 10+ years of B2B enterprise marketing experience with blended expertise in integrated campaigns, account-based marketing, and demand generation
Have experience marketing AI/ML or complex technical products to enterprise customers
Have experience building and leading integrated campaign or demand generation teams
Have deep knowledge of account-based marketing (ABM) strategies and execution, including platforms such as 6sense or Demandbase
Have experience at high-growth technology companies such as Stripe, AWS, Okta, Snowflake, or Workday
Have experience developing industry- or segment-specific campaign motions for regulated or vertical markets
Have experience managing and directing agency partners to extend internal team capacity
Have marketing automation and campaign operations fluency (e.g., Marketo, Salesforce) with an understanding of lead lifecycle management
Have international campaign experience and an understanding of how to localize enterprise programs across regions

jobs.description: Welcome to the Worldwide Returns & ReCommerce team (WWR&R) at Amazon.com. WWR&R is an agile, innovative organization dedicated to ‘making zero happen’ to benefit our customers, our company, and the environment. Our goal is to achieve the three zeroes: zero cost of returns, zero waste, and zero defects. We do this by developing products and driving truly innovative operational excellence to help customers keep what they buy, recover returned and damaged product value, keep thousands of tons of waste from landfills, and create the best customer returns experience in the world. We have an eye to the future – we create long-term value at Amazon by focusing not just on the bottom line, but on the planet. We are building the most sustainable re-use channel we can by driving multiple aspects of the Circular Economy for Amazon – Returns & ReCommerce. Amazon WWR&R is comprised of business, product, operational, program, software engineering and data teams that manage the life of a returned or damaged product from a customer to the warehouse and on to its next best use. Our work is broad and deep: we train machine learning models to automate routing and find signals to optimize re-use; we invent new channels to give products a second life; we develop highly respected product support to help customers love what they buy; we pilot smarter product evaluations; we work from the customer backward to find ways to make the return experience remarkably delightful and easy; and we do it all while scrutinizing our business with laser focus. You will help create everything from customer-facing and vendor-facing websites to the internal software and tools behind the reverse-logistics process. You can develop scalable, high-availability solutions to solve complex and broad business problems. We are a group that has fun at work while driving incredible customer, business, and environmental impact. We are backed by a strong leadership group dedicated to operational excellence that empowers a reasonable work-life balance. As an established, experienced team, we offer the scope and support needed for substantial career growth. Amazon is earth’s most customer-centric company and through WWR&R, the earth is our customer too. Come join us and innovate with the Amazon Worldwide Returns & ReCommerce team! Key job responsibilities * Design, develop, and evaluate highly innovative models for Natural Language Programming (NLP), Large Language Model (LLM), or Large Computer Vision Models. * Use SQL to query and analyze the data. * Use Python, Jupyter notebook, and Pytorch to train/test/deploy ML models. * Use machine learning and analytical techniques to create scalable solutions for business problems. * Research and implement novel machine learning and statistical approaches. * Mentor interns. * Work closely with data & software engineering teams to build model implementations and integrate successful models and algorithms in production systems at very large scale. About the team When a customer returns a package to Amazon, the request and package will be passed through our WWRR machine learning (ML) systems so that we could improve the customer experience, identify return root cause, optimize re-use, and evaluate the returned package. Our problems touch multiple modalities spanning from: textual, categorical, image, to speech data. We operate at large scale and rely on state-of-the-art modeling techniques to power our ML models: XGBoost, BERT, Vision Transformers, Large Language Models.

jobs.description:
Riot’s Anti-Cheat team is versatile and passionate about its craft. We understand the player impact of cheating in games and are focused on setting the highest bar for the integrity of multiplayer games. We relish the opportunity to work with low-level systems and take pride in developing creative, rigorous defenses against adversaries. At the most fundamental level, our goal is to promote the best player experience by protecting the legitimacy of their favorite games.
As a
Manager, Anti-Cheat Engineering
, you will lead the team responsible for the ongoing development and evolution of Vanguard Anti-Cheat’s Windows client services. You’ll set technical direction, shape priorities, and ensure the team delivers secure, reliable capabilities across Vanguard’s Anti-Cheat suite in a timely manner. While your primary focus will be enabling the team and driving outcomes, your strong fluency in cheat communities and techniques will allow you to guide architecture, challenge technical decisions, and step directly into complex debugging or investigations when needed. You’ll help the team anticipate and analyze emerging cheat techniques, then translate those findings into effective detections, mitigations, and preventative controls.
Responsibilities:
Manage, identify, recruit, interview, and hire engineers to help the team scale effectively
Set direction and drive high-impact anti-cheat capabilities from ambiguity through production across user-mode, kernel-mode, and obfuscation tooling surfaces
Lead the team in rapidly translating emerging threats into resilient detections and preventative countermeasures that can be safely deployed at scale
Balance immediate threat response with proactive technical investments that anticipate adversaries’ next moves or eliminate common abuse vectors entirely
Guide and participate in complex investigations involving highly evasive cheats and operating-system manipulation techniques
Ensure the team can diagnose and resolve complex compatibility, reliability, and security issues in highly opaque environments, stepping into the details when needed
Build trusted relationships with game teams as internal customers, helping them understand their cheating ecosystems, integrate Anti-Cheat effectively, and make informed tradeoffs across security, player experience, scope, and delivery
Establish clear priorities and technical expectations, helping engineers navigate uncertainty and make sound decisions across security, compatibility, performance, and operational risk
Partner across engineering, product, operations, and game teams to align dependencies, communicate risk, and deliver anti-cheat capabilities successfully across Riot’s portfolio
Required Qualifications:
2+ years of experience leading product or developing engineers, either as an Engineering Manager or as a Technical Product Lead
Familiarity with cheat-development or game-security research communities and a practical understanding of modern cheat techniques and anti-cheat evasions
Strong understanding of Anti-Cheat architectures, with the ability to evaluate designs, guide technical discussions, and engage directly when complex problems require it
Experience leading work on low-level, security-sensitive systems and helping teams navigate tradeoffs across security, reliability, compatibility, performance, and delivery
Working knowledge of Windows security model and security feature suite such as Secure Boot, HVCI, and measured boot attestation
Desired Qualifications:
Familiarity with reverse-engineering techniques and workflows, including the analysis of packed, protected, or obfuscated binaries, with the judgment to translate technical findings into priorities, investments, and defensive strategy
Working knowledge of the Windows kernel and driver model, sufficient enough to guide architecture, assess technical risk, and oversee the development and operation of production-grade kernel-mode drivers
Working knowledge of advanced evasion techniques involving hypervisors, DKOM, EPT manipulation, vulnerable drivers, or hardware-assisted cheats, with the ability to reason about their implications for product and technical strategy
Basic understanding of runtime integrity verification, behavioral detection, client attestation, and other signature-less anti-cheat techniques, including how to prioritize investments across these defensive approaches
Experience balancing near-term responses to emerging threats with longer-term, proactive investments intended to anticipate how adversaries and the broader security landscape will evolve
Experience partnering with internal customers, building trusted relationships, translating their needs into technical priorities, and leading productive conversations around scope, risk, sequencing, and delivery tradeoffs
For this role, you'll find success through craft expertise, a collaborative spirit, and decision-making that prioritizes the delight of players. We will be looking at your past studies, experience, and your personal relationship with games. If you embody player empathy and care about players' experiences, this could be your role!
Our Perks:
Riot focuses on work/life balance, shown by our open paid time off policy and other perks such as flexible work schedules. We offer medical, dental, and life insurance, parental leave for you, your spouse/domestic partner, and children, and a 401k with company match. Check out our
benefits pages
for more information.

put players first
. That mission drives every decision in our quest to create games and experiences that make it better to be a player. Whether you’re working directly on a new player-facing experience or you’re supporting the company as a whole, everyone at Riot is part of our mission. And just like in our games, we’re better when we work together. Our goal is to create collaborative teams where you are empowered to bring your unique perspective everyday.
